resources.string: Lets zenvqo.voice finish what you asked by voice: press Send in WhatsApp, ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini, start the first YouTube video, flip the Wi-Fi / Bluetooth / mobile data / hotspot switch, take a screenshot or lock the phone, press a button by its name, type or scroll in the app on screen, and search inside apps. It also adds a floating zenvqo.voice button so you can talk from inside any app. It only acts right after your own voice command.
